title: PII detection recall and precision
description: Redaction quality is really two failures wearing one coat: missing an identifier leaks data, and inventing one destroys the text. This contract grades both directions separately, and compares the same detector across regions and confidence thresholds - the knob teams actually turn in production, usually without measuring what it costs them.
